items.q: How do I create an account?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Open Register, fill in the email, code, username, password and mobile number, then accept the terms. This demo build validates the form locally and creates nothing.

items.q: Which username can I choose?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Four to twenty characters, letters and digits only, no spaces. The username cannot be changed later.

items.q: How do I make my first deposit?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Open Deposit, choose bank transfer or a payment gateway, then enter the amount and reference number. A reviewer approves the first request.

items.q: What is the minimum deposit?
items.a: Placeholder answer. RM 30 for QR channels, RM 50 for bank transfer and payment gateways.

items.q: How long does a deposit take to appear?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Under five minutes once the request is approved. Bank transfers sent after banking hours are credited the next business day.

items.q: Where do I find my referral code?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Profile shows the code. Both sides receive a credit after the friend's first qualifying deposit.

items.q: Why was my deposit request held for review?
items.a: Placeholder answer. First deposits and any request without a matching reference number go to a human reviewer. Nothing is lost while it waits.

items.q: How do I withdraw?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Open Withdrawal, pick a verified bank account, enter the amount and submit. The request appears under Pending transactions.

items.q: What are the withdrawal limits?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Minimum RM 50 and maximum RM 5,000 per request in this demo data.

items.q: Is there a withdrawal fee?
items.a: Placeholder answer. The first withdrawal each month carries no fee; later ones carry a small fee that the request form shows before submission.

items.q: Why do I need a document check?
items.a: Placeholder answer. A bank account must pass one document check before it can receive a payout. This is done once per bank account.

items.q: How do I move money between wallets?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Open Transfer, pick the source and destination wallets and the amount. Auto-transfer returns winnings to the main wallet after each round.

items.q: Can I cancel a pending request?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Yes, from Pending transactions while the reviewer has not picked it up. Cancelling releases any held amount.

items.q: Where can I see my transactions?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Transaction history lists deposits, withdrawals, transfers, rebates and bonuses. Filter by type and status.

items.q: What does the rollover block show?
items.a: Placeholder answer. It tracks the turnover still required on active promotions, with the requirement and the progress made so far.

items.q: How far back do records go?
items.a: Placeholder answer. The demo data holds 12 months. The live build keeps records for as long as the licence requires.

items.q: Can I download a statement?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Not in this build. Export arrives with the member area update.

items.q: Why does a row show a different amount?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Bonus rows show the bonus amount, not the deposit it came from. The reference number ties the two together.

items.q: How do I find a specific game?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Use the search box on the slots page. Results update as you type and the address bar keeps the query.

items.q: Why are category tabs different per studio?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Each studio publishes its own categories, so the tab row follows the studio rather than the site.

items.q: Why does Play Now do nothing?
items.a: Placeholder answer. This demo build never launches a game. Both Play Now and Demo are inert so the browsing flow can be reviewed safely.

items.q: What is the VPN notice about?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Some live tables and esports lobbies ask you to turn off a VPN before opening. The notice is the end of the flow here.

items.q: How often does the number game draw?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Every five minutes, six numbers from 1 to 49. Each round is committed before the draw.

items.q: How does 4D work?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Four draws a week. Pick a 4-digit number and a bet type; prize tiers are First, Second and Third with consolation prizes.

items.q: How does the ranking board work?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Each board ranks turnover for its period. Names are masked on purpose and prizes are credited within 48 hours of a board closing.

items.q: What is the difference between the boards?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Weekly and monthly races cover all products; the VIP boards only count invited accounts; the live board updates continuously.

items.q: How do prediction entries work?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Pick an outcome before kick-off. Correct picks earn points for the monthly board. Entries are free and closed in this build.

items.q: How are tickets earned?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Tickets accumulate from play. Each event spends a fixed number of tickets when you enter.

items.q: When is the board data refreshed?
items.a: Placeholder answer. The public boards refresh every 15 minutes; the live board streams continuously in the live build.

items.q: How do I use a voucher code?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Open Voucher (Promo Code) from the header, paste the code and submit. Guest visitors are asked to sign in first.

items.q: What is turnover?
items.a: Placeholder answer. The total amount that must be wagered before bonus money can be withdrawn. Each product contributes at a different rate.

items.q: Why did my bonus expire?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Bonuses carry an expiry date and unused bonus balance is removed when it passes.

items.q: Can I hold two bonuses at once?
items.a: Placeholder answer. No. An active bonus must be finished or cancelled before another can be claimed.

items.q: How is rebate different from a bonus?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Rebate is cash with no turnover requirement; a bonus carries turnover and an expiry date.

items.q: Where do I see my rollover progress?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Transaction history shows the rollover block for each active promotion.

items.q: What is the fastest way to reach support?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Live chat, open around the clock. The contact page lists every channel with its expected response time.

items.q: What should I have ready?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Your username and, for anything about money, the reference number from the transaction row.

items.q: How long does a reply take?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Live chat answers in under two minutes on median. Email is answered within four hours.

items.q: How do I report a game that froze?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Note the round ID shown by the game and send it to support. The round is settled automatically either way.

items.q: Where do I send feedback?
items.a: Placeholder answer. The contact form on this site reaches the product team; it is a demo form in this build.

items.q: Is there a mobile app?
items.a: Placeholder answer. The site runs in the browser on phones and installs as a shortcut. A packaged app is planned.

items.q: Why does the app banner appear?
items.a: Placeholder answer. It points at this topic. It can be dismissed and stays dismissed on that device.

items.q: Does the mobile site have every feature?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Yes: browsing, deposits, withdrawals, promotions and the member area are all available at 375px.

items.q: How do I add the site to my home screen?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Open the browser menu and choose Add to Home Screen. It then opens without browser chrome.

items.q: Will I get draw alerts?
items.a: Placeholder answer. Not in this build. Notifications arrive with the app release.
